item.text: The core issue is clear: `canMessageUser` currently checks only the sender’s basic `chat` privilege, while every chat route shares middleware that checks only that privilege. Invitations already call `canMessageUser`, but currently ignore its semantic limitation. I’m tracing profile serialization and room membership paths now so the new gate covers both direct chats and invited targets without weakening ordinary chat access.
